mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized over the previous two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the inflation signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the previous month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator for economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances despite the housing market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the easing signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points, signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous two months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances despite the supply contraction signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 5% over the previous six months signals robust consumer demand, which is a strong indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances despite the consumer demand signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% annualized over the previous two months signals a potential stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL > 2% annualized in 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the stagflation signal.
